concepts.name: shadcn/ui
concepts.differentiation: 디자인 시스템 자체가 차별점: Neutral zinc/slate palette with CSS custom properties, subtle borders, rounded-md (0.375-0.5rem), Inter-like sans stack, quiet shadows, muted-foreground secondary text, clear focus rings.

tokenOverlay.fontStack: 'Inter', 'Pretendard', -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
tokenOverlay.shadow: quiet — shadow-sm(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05))만 카드/CTA에 사용, hover에도 확대하지 않음

concepts.name: SEED (Daangn)
concepts.differentiation: 디자인 시스템 자체가 차별점: Daangn SEED foundations: warm functional palette with semantic fg/bg/stroke roles, friendly rounded shapes, mobile-first density, clear pressed/disabled states, Pretendard-like Korean type.

tokenOverlay.fontStack: 'Pretendard', -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
tokenOverlay.shadow: none-to-minimal — 그림자 대신 배경 톤 레이어(bg-layer)로 면을 구분, 하단 고정 CTA 바에만 얇은 상단 보더

concepts.name: Wanted Montage (web)
concepts.direction: Wanted Montage (web) 공식 시스템 적용 (구조 고정)
concepts.differentiation: 디자인 시스템 자체가 차별점: Wanted Montage web design system (@wanteddev/wds): professional product feel, confident primary color usage, structured spacing, crisp typography hierarchy, businesslike restraint.

tokenOverlay.fontStack: 'Pretendard', -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
tokenOverlay.shadow: crisp-and-restrained — 카드에는 보더만, 고정 하단 CTA 바에 0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06) 정도의 얕은 분리 그림자

rationaleSummary: Structure is FIXED to runs/wf-wedding-r3/wireframe-wizard.html (하객 초대장 페이지, screen w-guest): all three concepts render the identical 12-block section order, so the differences between concept-shadcn, concept-seed, and concept-wanted-montage are pure design-system style (palette, radius, type, shadow, button language). Clients compare style only; any structural feedback routes back to the wireframe stage rather than being absorbed here.
